note: Pilot, one arm only: design-doc 1.5.3 as shipped, no skill change. Question: what does the skill do today with template sections the template itself marks as dispensable? Check list frozen before any run and not edited to fit an output. Not added to evals.json or checks-baseline.json: this is an observation that decides whether a change is worth making, not yet a spec. kind=file is decided by a script; kind=reading is decided by one reader (the session that ran the pilot, not blind: there is a single arm) and must quote the words, or record the search when the answer is no. Checks O.* are observations, not pass/fail: 'expected_under_proposal' says what the proposed rule would produce.
